component.name: NetNeighbor
component.summary: Discover and monitor devices on your local network
Découvrez et surveillez les appareils de votre réseau local

description.p: NetNeighbor discovers and monitors devices on your local network, a modern equivalent of the Windows Network Neighborhood experience.

ul.li: Automatic discovery with SSDP, mDNS/Bonjour, WS-Discovery and NetBIOS, without active port scanning
List and icon grid views, grouped by device type or location
One-click access through HTTP, HTTPS, SMB, SSH, FTP, SFTP or Telnet
Per-device overrides for name, type, location, icon and commands
